title: A triangle
prompt: Draw a triangle with sides of 60. At each corner turn left by 120, not 90: `turn_left(120)`.
hints: turn_left can take a number of degrees.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func solve():
	move_forward(60)
	turn_left(120)
	move_forward(60)
	turn_left(120)
	move_forward(60)
	turn_left(120)
